attributes.action: Ban doctor receptionist’s from requesting medical information.
attributes.additional_details:
We believe doctors receptionist’s have no right to ask for medical symptoms when asking to see a doctor and they should not have the authority to decide whether or not a patient gets an appointment.

Receptionists are not qualified to assess patients symptoms and patients have the right to confidentiality.
attributes.background: Ban doctor receptionist’s from asking a patient for personal medical reasons why they are requesting an appointment to see a doctor.

rejection.details: It is up to individual practices how they chose to triage their patients.
